use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building a multi-tenant conversational support assistant + document search/reranking for customers. Current infra is mostly cloud-hosted; want to move latency-sensitive work to Dedicated nodes to reduce 99th percentile tail latency and TCO. Interested in test of model multiplexing for personalization and rerank pipelines.
technical_requirements: Targets: p99 latency < 300ms for short-chat tokens, sustained throughput ~3k reqs/min for peak periods. Need KV/prefix caching, multi-model routing (small quantized variants for low-cost fallbacks), region failover between us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Must support SSO/SAML for console access and integrate with customer KMS for at-rest key control.
poc_scope: 6-week Dedicated POC: week1 infra + network setup (VPC peering, CIDR, firewall), week2 model onboarding and quantization test, week3 canary rollout (10% production-like traffic routed to Dedicated), week4 reliability + fallback testing (simulate node loss + region failover), week5 stress/load tests and performance tuning, week6 cutover plan + wrap-up + success criteria review.
canary_and_routing_plan: Canary: start at 10% traffic -> 30% -> 60% over 2 weeks with close monitoring. Routing: header-based routing to map customer-tier traffic to Dedicated pools. Fallback policy: automatic fallback to hosted model-variant (cheaper 4-bit quant) when Dedicated capacity saturated or latency SLO breached. Model variants: full fp16 base model for high-quality responses, int8/int4 quantized variants for cost fallback. Rollback: immediate 100% reroute to hosted via route policy, preserve KV cache sync window of 120s before failback to avoid cold-start spikes.
security_notes: They require SAML SSO for console and service accounts. KMS integration required for customer-managed keys. Legal asked for SOC2 type II and encryption-in-transit details. Data residency: sensitive EU tenant data must stay in eu-west-1 — plan to configure tenant routing based on tenant metadata.
commercial_notes: Mid-market ARR ask: pricing model comparison requested for hosted-only vs mixed hosted+dedicated over 12 months. They asked for committed-node discount tiers and burst credits. AE ran a quick back-of-envelope: at 5M tokens/day committed nodes become cost-effective at mid tier. Procurement asked for a 60-day POC rate card and sandbox invoice sample.
